parsed.rationale: Regular rhythm with P waves and a narrow QRS, with rS/QS complexes and poor R-wave progression in V1-V3 and ST elevation of about 2-4 mm from V1 to V5 that exceeds the V2-V3 STEMI threshold, which fits an acute anterior (LAD-territory) infarct; LVH is the main alternative but the voltage is too low.
